prompt: The card looks wrong at 320px. Check it and tell me what's off.
why: The right move is `npm run smoke` first, and /browser-verify before hand-driving anything. The wrong move -- hand-rolling a browser on a port with a live service worker -- verifies against files already changed and passes.

checks.expect: the session reaches for scripts/smoke.mjs before driving a browser by hand
if it does drive a browser, /browser-verify is loaded and the service worker is unregistered on a fresh port first
no claim of an iOS Safari result, which no session on this machine can produce
